issues.description: StockIngredient's name getter is inconsistent between template and solution: the template exposes getIngredientName(), while the solution (and its Stock.findStockIngredient implementation) uses getName(). This breaks interoperability between provided starter code and the reference behavior and can lead students to implement/findStockIngredient using a different accessor than expected by tests/reference.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize on a single getter name across template and solution (preferably getName() to match the UML attribute 'name'). Rename template's getIngredientName() to getName() (or add getName() delegating to getIngredientName() for compatibility) and ensure Stock.findStockIngredient uses the standardized getter.
